]> 12/08/2026 6:57 Another 5cm of fresh snow!.

It's another wintery day here at Perisher. It's currently foggy in the valley and -1.3 degrees. We've had around 5cm of fresh snow since yesterday afternoon and the snow makers were able to fire up the guns for a few hours overnight too.

We're headed for a top of 1 degrees and there's a high chance the snow showers will continue throughout the day. Winds are forecast to be westerly 35 to 50 km/h.

41 lifts are set to spin today, though keep an eye on the lift report as the winds may impact some lift operations. The Perisher App will also keep you posted with real-time updates.

We have 53 runs groomed across the resort and Blue Cow, Perisher and Guthega are all still interlinked, offering plenty of space.

This should be the last stormy day before conditions start to clear up as we head towards the weekend.
